query:
SELECT s.id, s.type, s.value, s.due_day, s.start_date, s.end_date, s.status, ac.name as clientName
FROM subscriptions s
INNER JOIN allowed_clients ac ON s.client_id = ac.id
WHERE ac.name LIKE '%Lucas%'
ORDER BY s.value DESC;
